decision_conditions: The site is located to the south of the Islington borough boundary, south of the Chiswell Street Conservation Area and south of the Grade II listed 38 Chiswell Street (all within Islington). Due to the siting and scale of the development it is not considered that it would unacceptably harm the amenity of Islington residents. However, the City of London should ensure that the setting of the designated heritage assets within Islington are not harmed by the development. The proposal should be assessed in line with the City of London’s planning policies.
description: Partial demolition of existing building, alteration and extension of the existing hotel to include additional floor space upward, altered and additional entrances; eternal urban greening; external plant exclosures; facade alterations; internal alterations; and associated works. (24/00863/FULL).
